rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Vuvuzela
rows.Origin:
Bred by Pierre Orard (France, before 2010).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2010 as 'Vuvuzela'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow and coral orange, orange-red edges. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
